name: fpga-reverify-weekly
prompt: Re-run the FPGA design verification for the checked-in example. Run `/fpga:gates` on the workspace contract (or `python3 $FPGA_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/fpga_launcher.py gates <contract>`), compare the verdicts to the recorded ones in the design report, and write a short result to observations/fpga/. If any gate regressed from pass to fail or unknown, say so explicitly in the run summary.
